description: Windsor.ai is a no-code data integration platform for connecting marketing, advertising, analytics, e-commerce, CRM, and database sources to reporting destinations and AI tools. It lets users query connected business data and, for some connectors, perform write actions such as campaign management.
summary: windsor.ai exposes two developer integration surfaces: a bearer-token-authenticated HTTP Connectors API at `connectors.windsor.ai` and an OAuth/API-key-protected remote MCP server at `mcp.windsor.ai` (streamable HTTP with SSE).
